title: Tall white children's play saucer

tellings.quote: a saucer that you might have for your children to take out to the play area, which I also saw. It's not meant to go faster than light.

plain: In the Indian Springs Valley in Nevada in the 1960s, tall, white-skinned aliens kept a small saucer for their children to take out to a play area, a craft not built to fly faster than light. Charles Hall, a man who calls himself a whistleblower and says he spent three years with these beings near Area 51, a secret US Air Force test site, tells Jesse Michels he saw it himself. If true, it would mean whole alien families living near a US base.
